description:
FILED s540b (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-13), docs/speed-low-hanging-review-s540.md THE LIST.  Code sha 05806e16.

WHERE: lib/Digest/MD5.pm (190 lines of pure-Perl MD5: 32-bit arithmetic with masks, unpack/pack per block).  Its algorithm is the cost, not PCL's execution of it: perl running the SAME shim text is 265 us per KB (shimbench under `perl -I scratch/s540b/shim/plib2`), PCL 410 us.

MEASUREMENT (scratch/s540b/shim/shimbench.pl, md5_hex of 1,000 bytes; final numbers legs/leg4.log): PCL shim 410 us a call (exploratory, SCALE 0.1, load 2-3; leg4 re-takes it quiet); perl XS 1.3 us; sb-md5 on the same input, hex-formatted with FORMAT (scratch/s540b/lev/md5-prim.lisp): 6.7 us a call, digest identical (33ef314bbf752a16bcc48256b4b89e8e).
Prevalence: 93 md5 / Digest::MD5->new sites in 30 files over perl's lib + the board dists + everyday; everyday/programs/Digest-SHA-MD5.pl uses it.

THE FIX: a `builtin::` primitive (DECIDED: `builtin::` is the blessed shim-dispatch seam) over sb-md5 -- the one-shot md5 / md5_hex / md5_base64 on a byte string (a string with a char above 255 dies "Wide character" as perl does), and the OO interface (new / add / addfile / digest / hexdigest / b64digest / reset / clone) over sb-md5's make-md5-state / update-md5-state / finalize-md5-state.  The shim keeps its Perl surface; only the compression moves.  Rule 9a: the module name stays in lib/; cl/ gets a generic md5 primitive.

BAR: the Digest-MD5 dist's own tests if on the board (Pl/t/xs-03.t's md5-aaa.t is the pclxs path -- parked), the everyday Digest-SHA-MD5 program, guard rows with perl's digests for '', 'a', 1 KB, 1 MB, a string with \xff, and the OO add-in-pieces = one-shot identity.

DO NOT: hash a CHARACTER string with chars > 255 by encoding it silently (perl dies); do not route through the pclxs bridge (parked).

=== QUIET NUMBERS (s540b legs/leg4.log, load 1.1-1.4) === md5_hex(1K): PCL 356,030 ns, perl running the shim text 264,922, perl XS 1,162; sb-md5 primitive 6,650 ns (digest identical).
subject: PERF (s540b, measured): Digest::MD5's shim computes MD5 in pure Perl -- 410 us per KB under PCL (perl's XS 1.3 us) -- while the runtime ALREADY loads SBCL's sb-md5 (cl/pcl-runtime.lisp line 105, for the module cache's manifest): routed through a `builtin::` primitive it is ~7 us per KB, 60x
